# Wintergill Paper Merchants - stock

Shared folder for the warehouse office.

- stock/  cards for each pallet and board line
- haulage/  delivery notes from the mill

turns.prompt: A buyer at Wintergill Paper Merchants asked what the ream weight of a board line means; a ream is 500 sheets, so its weight follows from the grammage of a single sheet. The kraft liner line is cut 0.9 metres by 0.64 metres at 80 grams per square metre. Give the weight of one ream of that line, as a single number in kilograms with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
